origin.description: Report whether an object is a message.
origin.details: True only for a message condition.
origin.example:
cat("A message is a message:", is.message(simpleMessage("a")), "\n")
cat("A warning is not:", is.message(simpleWarning("a")), "\n")

translation.description: Report whether an object is a message.
translation.details: True only for a message condition.
translation.example:
print("A message is a message:", is_message(Message("a")))
print("A warning is not:", is_message(Warning("a")))
